bio: In a charming area of Treviso's historic centre, the Morer restaurant offers fresh seafood dishes, homemade pastas and desserts. Not to be missed are the lemon noodles and the scallop with its coral and pepper. Not far from the Cathedral, this historic venue is named after a mulberry tree – morer, in the local dialect – once located in front of the entrance, but which is now gone!...
